blurb: Guests enjoy worry-free charters on a 25 ft pontoon boat with an experienced operator who drives. Charters include the first half tank of gas and customizable activities like swimming, floating, and visiting sandbars. Safety is prioritized with life jackets, CPR-certified operators, and no glass containers allowed.
extraNote: Cancellations must be 24 hours in advance to receive a refund · $100 fee applies to all cancellations · Partial refund minus $50 fee if canceled prior to boarding · If charter stops due to lightning, partial refund up to 30% may apply if less than 50% time expired · No refund if 50% or more of charter time has expired · Check weather prior to charter time
